## Hypothesis

Extending the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE study to 3DTE and 4DTE will reveal whether the monotonic increase in OOS exp/tr ($36.34 → $59.02 → $66.13) continues beyond 2DTE. The edge may persist due to lower theta decay on entry premium at longer weekly DTE, or may reverse due to increased gamma risk or liquidity premium erosion.

## Mechanism

Same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: trade the `vwap_continuation` signal (ITM-2 strike, -8%/+30% exit) but now evaluate DTE=0,1,2,3,4 using backfilled OPRA data. Entry at next bar open after signal trigger. Exit logic unchanged: chart stop (rejected level ±$0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (+5% arm, 0.15 trail), premium stop (−50% catastrophe cap), time stop 15:50 ET. Only the DTE variable changes via `_expiry_for_setup` picker.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** OOS exp/tr is per-contract metric; account size does not affect the value as long as ≥1 contract can be traded. For 4DTE ITM-2 puts (est. premium $5-$10), a $1,000 account can trade 1 contract at 50% risk cap. Existing candidate's backtest used Safe account parameters (automation/state/params.json) for 0DTE ITM-2 puts (~$0.85-$1.67 premium, 3 contracts at $1K account). No change to position sizing logic; study measures edge per contract.
2. **Sample bias:** Uses same date range (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) for all DTE (0-4). 3DTE/4dte OPRA backfill adds ~8,090 calls (all available SPY options with 3/4 DTE in range). Selection method: exhaustive OPRA data pull. Overfit risk: low — extending same study to more DTE points without engine changes.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will be available after running multiday_dte_compare.py with extended DTE range; script computes walk-forward held-out OOS exp/tr)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate top 3 J days for 3DTE/4dte via realistic OPRA fill comparison vs. simulation; diff must be <±20%)
5. **Failure modes:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will enumerate worst day, max drawdown, blow-up scenario e.g., gap risk, liquidity crunch, theta decay acceleration)
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will state top-5 days % of P&L after backtest)
